record_scope_reconstruction: A tractor blockade at the named Evzoni/Bogorodica international road crossing, with police placing the road obstruction at Athens–Evzonoi kilometre548. This is a single road-route incident; Idomeni is geographic context, not evidence of a railway closure.

source_checks.finding: January31 AMSM-derived report says Evzoni on Greek side blocked since January30 at16:30 for passenger/cargo vehicles. This independently names the Greek road post but does not supply coordinates.
February4 original reports sixth day of Evzoni–Bogorodica blockage in both directions; Doirani and Medzitlija remain alternatives. Not evidence of a whole-frontier closure.
February17 early-morning AMSM-derived bulletin still reports the named crossing shut to all vehicles. Its publication precedes the reopening report and is not a precise final closure timestamp.
OFAE February17 original reports free movement of goods and passengers through Evzoni restored that morning and farmer withdrawal. Exact clearance minute is unstated.
Original customs URL returned502; no freshly inspected customs body or11:00 reopening clock is claimed here.

AFP original reproduced by L’Orient-Le Jour January31 places about200 farmers and tractors at Evzoni checkpoint, obstructing trucks. Its tax/social-contribution explanation is crossing-specific; no precise barrier coordinate or closed duration supplied. Full article body lines322–328 inspected.
Anadolu January31 original identifies roads to Evzoni blocked since the preceding evening and places the protest near Idomeni. The Idomeni reference is not evidence of a rail stoppage.

Primary Greek Police restrictions table lists Kilkis jurisdiction, Athens–Evzonoi road548 km, start15:00 January30, continuing until further notice, with Doirani diversion. It identifies the road route but gives no coordinate for the kilometre marker.

Original OSM way783378352 version6 February2025, named Evzoni checkpoint. Polygon bbox centre22.5515844,41.1276783 matches the proposed crossing reference after rounding. Current feature geometry is not proof of the historical barrier footprint.

sites.name: Evzoni road border checkpoint
sites.coordinate_method: Published Mapcarta coordinate independently checked against fresh original named OSM checkpoint-polygon geometry; bounding-box centre agrees at five decimal places.
sites.precision: Approximate named feature reference, not surveyed historical gate or barrier; published decimal precision is not accuracy.
sites.evidence_note: Road checkpoint shared with Bogorodica. Original named OSM compound independently confirms the existing proposed coordinate. Police specify the blockade at kilometre 548 of the Athens–Evzonoi road; no exact georeferenced kilometre/barrier location is recovered. The checkpoint is an approximate route reference, not a surveyed protest footprint; nearby Idomeni railway is excluded.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Passenger and cargo motor-vehicle route through Evzoni–Bogorodica in both directions. No rail closure, pedestrian closure or entire Greece–North Macedonia frontier closure is approved.

date_scope_check.assessment: Originals agree on January30 onset but differ between police15:00 and AMSM16:30 clocks. February17 morning-still-closed and later reopening reports are compatible with an intraday reopening, whose exact minute is unresolved. Keep native January30–February17 dates,18 calendar-day qualification and pedestrian/perishable exceptions; no new duration conclusion.

unresolved: Exact historical barrier at the police-reported 548 km point remains unlocated. A current checkpoint-compound reference does not establish the precise 2017 obstruction footprint or uninterrupted access exceptions.
